Context: 2. Applicability.-

The following column is to be added in the Self-Appraisal form as Column 4 in the case of Groups 'A' and 'B' Officers only:-  
"Please state whether the annual return on immovable property for the preceding calendar year was filed within the prescribed date, January of the year following the calendar year. If not, the date of  
- i,e., 31st filing the return should be given."
